method: Independent read-only static audit of all 65 frozen web/tests files, including the visual preview-server fixture. Scope was coordinated with the Web production reviewer: production TS/TSX, CSS and entry configuration are covered by that reviewer and are not counted here. Read AGENTS.md and honored the user override requiring two complete consecutive clean rounds before full tests. Verified all assigned source hashes at the start and end. Read the current-round AST extractor logic and independently inspected every file contract from the current-round extraction: all declared test contracts and assertions, fixtures and top-level declarations, lifecycle hooks, imports, and recursively extracted calls/effects, plus a fresh independent AST extraction of conditional/logical branches. The reading view removed only exact duplicated snippets already present in another displayed fixture/assertion/hook; truncated displays were reread in smaller ranges or by full source. This is full static AST-contract coverage, not a claim that every line of every test body was manually read. In addition, manually read all source text of the six listed high-risk tests/fixture. Reviewed authentication/MFA and stale-session handling, operation identity and unknown-result recovery, draft/attachment ownership and revision preservation, approvals and structured MCP answers, process/terminal/realtime cleanup, workspace/Git mutation boundaries, queue/history workflows, and receipt export/rotation contracts. Independently parsed all 65 files again, checked relative imports and all assigned hashes, and recomputed the complete 1880-file source snapshot. No tests, builds, business/model calls, real MCP, personal CODEX_HOME reads, old implementation, Git history or prior-round audit conclusions were used. Fixture mocks and assertions are static evidence of intended coverage, not proof that production behavior passes dynamically.
